page.content:
Angelica, Eliza, and Peggy — the Albany sisters who rewrite Hamilton's private life.

How the Schuyler sisters connects

  • Character: Eliza Schuyler Hamilton — Eliza is the sister who marries Hamilton.
  • Character: Angelica Schuyler Church — Angelica is the sister who matches Hamilton's mind.
  • Work: Hamilton (musical) — The Schuyler sisters are the family trio at the center of Hamilton's private plot.
  • Character: Peggy Schuyler — Peggy is the third Schuyler sister in the greeting trio.

What is the Schuyler sisters?

The Schuyler sisters are Angelica, Eliza, and Peggy Schuyler, the trio who greet New York in 'The Schuyler Sisters' and then split Hamilton's heart between Eliza's marriage and Angelica's matching mind.

Key threads lead to Eliza Schuyler Hamilton, Angelica Schuyler Church, Hamilton (musical) and Peggy Schuyler.
